# BindMemMgmt

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Subscribes an event to the kernel's memory-pressure notifications.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0A` SVC_BIND | `EVENT_MEMMGMT (1)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err BindMemMgmt(Handle ev_handle);
```

**Registers:** `(EVENT_MEMMGMT, event) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ev_handle` | in | Event handle with PERM_CNTL. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `ev_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `ev_handle` is not an event. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `ev_handle` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The event has been destroyed. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | The event is already subscribed. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | No subscription slots left. |
